bulgarian_ax5_assessment.initial_header: Complete acoustic-guitar title and standard/reference metadata readable at accessibility size.
bulgarian_ax5_assessment.vertical_reachability_visible: Separate status and string-rail frames show the intended lower content at different scroll positions; full quest/counter/XP/end captions are visible in the rail capture.
bulgarian_ax5_assessment.horizontal_rail_limit: Sixth E4 partly beyond the horizontal viewport. Source StringRail.swift explicitly provides horizontal scrolling; neither these pixels nor the container-only reachability test establishes actual reveal/tap of the sixth chip.

candidate_change_limit: The parent has a local general lesson-header wrapping candidate for a French baseline finding. These 970a12d frames do not execute or verify that unpushed candidate or any newly proposed text edits.
limitations: Visual review by an AI of captured simulator pixels, not native-human typography/fluency certification.
No VoiceOver listening, spoken pronunciation, contrast measurement, physical-device interaction or full-app QA performed.
No claim for paywalls, other lessons/steps, quizzes, widgets, Watch, store screenshot/preview assets or App Store account configuration.
The Persian major/minor/credit isolation follow-up strings are not displayed in these first-lesson frames; no rendering signoff for those new proposals is inferred.
A successful matrix job and these limited readable captures do not imply release readiness.
